target.statement: Logistic Regression test accuracy of 0.75 on the balanced BRFSS 2015 diabetes dataset
target.dataset: BRFSS 2015 Diabetes Health Indicators (balanced version, 70,692 rows, 21 features)

compute.basis: The balanced dataset is a small public Kaggle CSV (~70k rows x 22 cols); training sklearn LogisticRegression (lbfgs, L2, 100 iters) plus an 80/20 split takes seconds, so the bulk of time is downloading the data and installing scikit-learn/pandas.

blockers: No code or configs released; the exact preprocessing (min-max scaling, train/test split seed) and hyperparameters (C, max_iter) must be inferred from the text
Exact 0.75 accuracy may not reproduce bit-for-bit without the original random seed and split
title: A Comparative Study of Diabetes Prediction Based on Lifestyle Factors Using Machine Learning
